# ci/cd: dependabot: setup time and timezone

Fix the hour at which Dependabot runs ([`schedule.time`](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/dependabot-version-updates/configuration-options-for-the-dependabot.yml-file#scheduletime), [`schedule.timezone`](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/dependabot-version-updates/configuration-options-for-the-dependabot.yml-file#scheduletimezone)). **Motivation:** "handling all similar pull requests simultaneously with other repositories" — the author's repositories share Dependabot settings, and a common time means one review session for all of them.
